changes: 🎤 Syndy Voice now speaks with a real AI voice (Google Cloud TTS, WaveNet, en-AU) instead of the browser's built-in text-to-speech — previously voice quality varied a lot depending on whatever voice each person's phone or browser happened to ship with. New google-tts.mjs function needs deploying, and a new GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY environment variable needs setting on Netlify (a Google Cloud API key with the Text-to-Speech API enabled). Diagnostics now checks this deployment too, and can tell the difference between "not deployed" and "deployed but the API key is missing."
